## Core Domains
- Healthcare (Patient portals, telemedicine, lab reports, menstrual cycle tracking, AI triage)
- SaaS (Multi-service booking platforms, task scheduling, internal workflows)

## Design Tools
- Figma (Primary tool for user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity UI design, component systems, and interactive prototypes)
- Canva (Brand identity, social media creatives, flyers, brochures, business cards, invitations)

## Key Projects
1. Healthcare Mobile App: Appointment booking, telemedicine consultations, lab reports, insurance, yoga & fitness routines, family health management.
2. Women's Health App: Menstrual health tracking, cycle calendar, period prediction, confidential health records, PCOD/PCOS guidance.
3. AI Healthcare Module: Reassuring conversational AI interaction flows and healthcare triage designed for simplicity and accessibility.
4. Diet & Nutrition Module: Nutrition tracking, calorie and macro targets, hydration meters, meal logging, health progress.
5. Invitation App: Curated invitation creation, customization canvas, RSVP tracking, modern sharing flow.
6. Service-Based Booking Platform: Multi-industry service discovery, provider calendar selection, transparent checkout, appointment management.
